name: new-window
description: Two overlapping rounded windows with the foreground window at bottom right.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Owner requested retaining the previous Copy drawing exactly as the new New Window identity. Both SVG files are byte-for-byte the former Copy source, including the foreground bottom-right sheet, background top-left partial border, standard object roundness, 2px outer bounds, exposed parallel page separation and junction breaks. This is a natural object silhouette, with no additional Square/Circle enclosure. Its artwork is original project geometry reused by explicit owner request. New identity remains draft; previous Copy approval is not inherited.

review.note: Owner approved every current static icon, style and supported frame on 2026-10-27. Motion approval is separate.
